description: Run a Python project's container-free pytest suite (FastAPI, Django with pytest-django, or a plain library) with coverage.py via pytest-cov — falling back to `coverage run -m pytest` + `coverage xml` when pytest-cov isn't installed — through whichever environment runner the project uses (`uv run --frozen`, `poetry run`, `pdm run`, `pipenv run`, `.venv/bin/python -m`, plain `python -m`), write a Cobertura report to `build/coverage/coverage.xml`, and read it with a small stdlib Python parser to report the exact line % and branch % (plus coverage.py's combined figure, the one `fail_under` compares) for the total and per file, with uncovered line ranges and partial branches for files under the bar. Only container-free tests count toward the gate — the `integration` marker (or `tests/integration/` directory) is always deselected, so the number is reproducible without Docker; integration coverage is measured only on explicit request and labeled as not the gate value. Honors the project's `[tool.coverage.run] source`/`omit`/`branch`, adds `--cov-branch`, neutralizes `fail_under` during the run (`--cov-fail-under=0`) so the skill compares against the requested bar itself, and reports "coverage not wired" instead of a false 0%. Invoke as `/iru-python-coverage [selector] [targets]` — `[selector]` uses `iru-python-test`'s syntax (paths, node ids, `-k "<expr>"`), `[targets]` is a comma-separated list of source files, directories, or dotted modules to report on (e.g. `app/services/books.py,apps.catalog`) — or `/iru-python-coverage` with no argument for whole-project coverage; a `bar: <N>` line sets the threshold (default 80). Use whenever the user (or a `iru-fastapi-*`/`iru-django-*` group skill via `iru-gate-runner`) wants to check, or verify a bar for, a Python file, package, or the whole project, instead of eyeballing `--cov-report=term-missing` output.
